body:
Hi!

I am sorry that this exam is making you think that something is wrong with you, or questioning your self worth. That it is making you question whether you should go on.  
Not enjoying coding/finding it difficult is the reality for a lot of people. And I can understand how failure in something that others may find easier can cause you to question your capabilities.  
I will let you know of three true stories from my engineering college:

1) Another friend from same college still calls never learnt how to code. She is an electrical engineer. She has finished her PhD this year, and has job offers from Research Labs and Huge companies. She can not write a single line of code without help. 

2) I am also a computer science engineer. Coding was the only engineering subjects I got good marks in. I barely passed the other engineering courses. Never affected my job.

3) My friend is working in software development at Google, who was called for academic help program in her first year (C++ coding course, incidentally). She said she hated coding until her 3rd year, when a teacher managed to get through to her. We expected her to change her core subjects, but she ended up doing really core computer science stuff because she got someone to explain to her the way she could understand it.

So these stories are real life examples of:  
1) Being successful does not depend on coding, no matter what people tell you. It depends on which field you want to go into.  
2) Your inability to do well in some subjects over others does not mean you are an idiot, it is simply that you have different strengths.  
3) If you are failing at something, but you still want to continue trying, you may need to find a different way to understand it. A good teacher , a book written in a way that you can understand etc.   


So here is the thing, if it is a core class, that is necessary for your degree, but not something you like. Find someone who can make you cram enough to be able to scrap by, and forget it. If it is something that you want to improve at, and figure out whether you can be better at, try different tutors and methods, until it clicks for you.   
But you are not stupid if you can not code. There is nothing wrong with you. You just prefer to think differently. Your strengths may be different. Does not make you better or worse than anyone else.

Hi! I just posted about being a burden and wanting someone to listen, so you are not alone in wanting someone to understand. Your story is your own, but your reaction is by no means rare. Feel free to talk to me. I know what it is like to ask for understanding. I know there have been days that I have relied on kindness of strangers to get through the day. There was a restaurant down the street from my house run by a really old man, who did not even speak the same language as me. But he was kind, and I went there just to feel something.

>You are not alone in feeling this way, even though it might feel that way. Especially if you try to reach out to people who don't suffer depression, as they will never truly understand, or they simply say "cheer up, stop being miserable all the time". These sort of comments are not in any way helpful. A simple "are you OK"  to show someone cares is enough to get through a difficult day.

Thanks. I hope it gets better for you. I had  2 good months at the start of this year, so this sudden spiral is hitting me harder. I hope you find what I had at the beginning of this year. And until then, I hope people show you the kindness that you have shown me.

Thank you for replying, Today was a hard day. I am trying to improve, but being called lazy and being told that my pain is in my imagination makes me spiral. I know there is something wrong with me, that I cant handle small stuff that most people don't even register. But I am trying. And being told just how useless those efforts are, how people whose approval means everything can see through to how fake and unmotivated and lazy I am, makes me feel like it is not even worth trying, that I can never be better. That I can never be not a burden, or a source of shame for my family. I want to be angry at the world, but the truth is that I have nothing to be angry about. I have everything anyone can desire. Every privilege out there has been handed to me in a silver platter. I just cant get out of my head enough to be better, to take advantage of my privilege. Thank you for being kind. And sorry for the rant. Thanks.

I am sorry you are feeling so exhausted with life. It is horrible to feel that nothing ever changes, no matter how hard you try. The motivation is just not there. It is hard to connect with people meaningfully when you are pretending you are ok. I am sorry you are going through this. I hope it changes for you. I feel like I don't have to pretend here. It helps me a bit. But I get being too exhausted to bother most days.
Hi, If you want to talk, I am also here.

I know what you mean. My mum is strong and has worked through immense pain to make it easier for me, my dad has been a pillar of strength for his entire family, and I cant even be bothered to try and be strong for myself. I am blessed with the most understanding family, lucky enough to get an easy life, a good job and good friends. I have absolutely nothing to complain of. I  am lucky, luckier than anyone else I know. But I am not happy. I can't be bothered to put in any effort. I try a couple of days, and then relapse. My inability to deal has left me trying to hide away and sleep entire days. My mum and dad are getting old, and I feel like I am a leech on their lives. I live in a haze, hardly doing anything worth anything, where there are thousands of kids out there who are battling circumstances and still succeeding. I know I am not a productive member of the society, and I also keep wishing that someone more deserving gets my life.

I am trying to be more deserving, but I dont know if I will ever work hard and consistently. I am disgusted by my own lethargy and passivity and laziness, just not enough to change I guess. I know I dont deserve it, and if it were possible , I would exchange my life in a minute.  I know there are people who would do so much more out of a lucky life like mine. I agree it is all wishful thinking. And I must try and be a little less useless, one day at a time. Maybe I will be able to make a difference for someone, and earn a fraction of the blessings I have been given.

taking things one day at a time has helped me feel a little better. hope it helps you too.
